systems.name: Das Payments V2 Datalocks
systems.description: This system processes data lock events related to apprenticeship payments, including updates and status changes. It handles various apprenticeship-related events such as creation, updates, payment issues, and account changes.

systems.name: Employer Finance
systems.description: The system manages financial data related to employer accounts, including levy declarations, payments, transfers, and account balances. It integrates with internal and external APIs to retrieve data and ensure accurate financial processing.

systems.name: Commitments
systems.description: The system manages apprenticeship commitments, including details about apprenticeships, cohorts, legal entities, data locks, courses, and related entities. It provides APIs for handling apprenticeships, cohorts, transfer requests, and other administrative interactions between employers and providers.

systems.name: Das Reservations
systems.description: This system manages reservations for apprenticeship levy and training allocations, supporting account-level entity management, reservation creation, and rule validations. It also handles events related to reservations, such as creation, updates, and deletion.

systems.name: Employer Accounts
systems.description: The Employer Accounts system manages employer accounts, legal entities, agreements, PAYE schemes, notifications, user memberships, and related settings. It provides functionalities for account creation, legal entity management, agreement signing, levy declarations, and associated administrative tasks.
